title: Gluing normalized lci curve adjunction over a locally Noetherian base
statement: Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $f:X\to S$ a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented morphism (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]), with nonempty geometric fibres pure of dimension one [def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-weil-pure-dimension]. Suppose $X$ is covered above base affine opens by regular affine curve presentations as defined in [def-trf-nodal-dualizing-datum]: $B=R[x_0,\ldots,x_c]/(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$ with the ordered equations regular in $R[x_0,\ldots,x_c]$. For each affine base open $V$, form the adjunction line $K_V$ with its specified determinant and Ext comparisons of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction] and the signed-Jacobian fundamental class $\alpha_V:\Omega^1_{X_V/V}\to K_V$ of [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class]. These lines, comparisons and maps have canonical restriction isomorphisms on affine refinements of overlaps of base affines; those isomorphisms identify the fundamental-class maps and satisfy the identity and triple-overlap cocycle equalities. They glue to an invertible module $K$ on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and a map $\alpha:\Omega^1_{X/S}\to K$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. The resulting pair, with its Ext comparisons, is a nodal dualizing datum of [def-trf-nodal-dualizing-datum]: its Jacobian formula holds in every regular affine curve presentation, using the sign-adjusted trivialization $e=\epsilon_c e_0$ of the cited fundamental-class lemma. On the relative smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $K$ is canonically $\Omega^1_{X/S}$ and $\alpha$ is an isomorphism. For every morphism $S'\to S$, including non-Noetherian $S'$, pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] identifies $K$ and $\alpha$ with the same adjunction and fundamental-class constructions on the pulled-back presentations. The comparisons commute with restriction, iterated base change, and isomorphisms of $S$-schemes; all identities are identities of the specified adjunction comparisons. No intersection of affine opens of $S$ is assumed affine. No properness or nodal singularity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0B6V (lemma-lci-shriek), 0E2Y (lemma-base-change-relative-dualizing), 0E9Y (lemma-determinant), 0E9Z (lemma-fundamental-class-lci). Agent affine-refinement gluing formulation of former item steps 4--5, using the existing signed fundamental-class comparison; not a claim that 0E9Z verbatim treats nonproper morphisms.

proof.text: For every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subset S$, $R$ is Noetherian by [pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth]; hence $V$ is Noetherian with its one-element affine cover. The restriction $f_V:X_V\to V$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change] and finitely presented by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3). Its geometric fibres are the same fibres as those of $f$ at points of $V$. $X_V$ is covered by regular affine curve presentations over affine opens of $V$: if $U=\operatorname{Spec}B$ over $V'=\operatorname{Spec}R$ is a given chart, with $B=R[x_0,\ldots,x_c]/(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$, cover $V\cap V'$ by standard opens $D(g)\subset V'$ with $g\in R$; the preimage of $D(g)$ in $U$ is $\operatorname{Spec}B_g$ with $B_g=R_g[x_0,\ldots,x_c]/(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$. Since localization is exact, multiplication by $f_i$ stays injective on $R_g[x_0,\ldots,x_c]/(f_1,\ldots,f_{i-1})=(R[x_0,\ldots,x_c]/(f_1,\ldots,f_{i-1}))_g$; if $B_g\neq0$ the ordered equations are again a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], and if $B_g=0$ the piece is empty and is omitted. These pieces cover $X_V$. Apply [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction] with $d=1$ and [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class] to obtain $K_V$, its specified adjunction and Ext comparisons, and $\alpha_V$. These applications require neither properness nor separatedness of $X_V/V$.

source.place: Tags 0B6V and 0E9Z, used through the cited nonproper adjunction/fundamental-class formulations; properties.tex Tag 01P0 for affine Noetherian rings.

proof.text: If $W\subset V$ are affine base opens, write $c_{V,W}:K_V|_{X_W}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_W$ for the specified base-change comparison of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction]. It carries $\alpha_V|_{X_W}$ to $\alpha_W$ by [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class]. For $Z\subset W\subset V$, the composition law gives $c_{V,Z}=c_{W,Z}(c_{V,W}|_{X_Z})$, and the identity comparison is $1$. In particular these are equalities of the stipulated comparisons, not isomorphisms chosen from existence. By [lem-sfb-adjunction-cotangent-determinant-normalization], each $c_{V,W}$ is the cotangent-determinant comparison in every local presentation, so it also uses exactly the stipulated presentation transitions.

source.place: Tag 0E2Y, restricted to open base changes; specified determinant normalization of the cited comparison nodes.

proof.text: For two affine base opens $V_i,V_j$, cover the possibly nonaffine intersection $V_i\cap V_j$ by affine opens $W$. On $X_W$ put $t_{ij,W}=c_{V_j,W}^{-1}c_{V_i,W}$. If $Z\subset W$ is affine, the preceding composition equality cancels the common $c_{W,Z}$ and gives $t_{ij,W}|_{X_Z}=t_{ij,Z}$. For two choices $W,W^{\prime}$, cover $W\cap W^{\prime}$ by smaller affine $Z$; these equalities show agreement there. Glue these maps and their inverses by part (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules], obtaining an isomorphism $t_{ij}$ on $X_{V_i\cap V_j}$. On an affine $W$ in a triple base intersection, $t_{jk,W}t_{ij,W}=c_{V_k,W}^{-1}c_{V_j,W}c_{V_j,W}^{-1}c_{V_i,W}=t_{ik,W}$. Equality detection in the same node gives the triple cocycle globally; likewise $t_{ii}=1$. The same calculation shows independence of affine refinements.

source.place: sheaves.tex Tags 04TN (lemma-glue-maps) and 00AN (lemma-mapping-property-glue); affine refinement and cancellation argument.

proof.text: Apply part (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules] to the cover $(X_{V_i})$ and the transitions $t_{ij}$ to get $K$ with identifications $K|_{X_{V_i}}\simeq K_{V_i}$. It is invertible: each point has a neighbourhood on which some $K_{V_i}$ is free of rank one, Thus it is locally a copy of the structure sheaf, in particular quasi-coherent, and satisfies [def-sc-invertible-module]. The equality $t_{ij,W}\alpha_{V_i}|_{X_W}=\alpha_{V_j}|_{X_W}$ from step 2 descends by equality detection; part (1) of the gluing node therefore supplies a unique $\alpha:\Omega^1_{X/S}\to K$. Here relative differentials restrict under base open immersions by [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and its universal-derivation compatibility: on a base localization the extension of a derivation is forced by $d(s^{-1})=-s^{-2}d(s)$; base coefficients have differential zero. Consequently: the structure map and differential module on a chart over $W$ are the same whether viewed over $V_i$ or $S$. Applying the same construction to the cover enlarged by any other affine base open identifies its local result with $K$, so the result is independent of the chosen affine cover.

source.place: sheaves.tex Tags 00AL (lemma-glue-sheaves), 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), 00AN; elementary local freeness and differential restriction.

proof.text: Take any regular affine curve presentation $U/V$, whether or not selected in the original cover. Over the affine $V$, [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class] gives its Jacobian formula with $e=\epsilon_c e_0$ and the prescribed comparison to $K_V$. Since step 4 identifies $K|_{X_V}$ with $K_V$ by those same comparisons, this proves the formula for $K$ in every presentation. The Ext isomorphisms are the ones of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction]. Their consistency under a change of polynomial presentation is explicitly supplied by [lem-trf-lci-koszul-duality-determinant-comparison]: its normalized derived duality comparisons correspond to the determinant transitions; [lem-sfb-adjunction-cotangent-determinant-normalization] identifies those with our transitions. Thus the Ext datum is retained, rather than re-chosen after gluing. Identifying the ambient top differential line with the coordinate volume form gives exactly the Ext clause of [def-trf-nodal-dualizing-datum]; invertibility, chart coverage, and the Jacobian formula give its other clauses.

source.place: Tags 0E9Y and 0E9Z; normalized dual Koszul comparison (Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext) and determinant presentation comparisons.

proof.text: The relative smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] is local on the base, so its intersection with $X_V$ is the relative smooth locus of $f_V$. By [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class], $\alpha_V$ is an isomorphism exactly on that locus. By step 4, $\alpha|_{X_V}$ is $\alpha_V$ under $K|_{X_V}\simeq K_V$, so $\alpha$ restricted to the smooth locus $X^{\rm sm}$ is an isomorphism on each $X^{\rm sm}\cap X_{V_i}$. The local inverses agree on overlaps, since each is the inverse of the restriction of the one map $\alpha$. They glue to a map $\beta$ by [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules](1), and $\alpha\beta=1$, $\beta\alpha=1$ by its equality detection. So $\alpha|_{X^{\rm sm}}:\Omega^1_{X^{\rm sm}/S}\to K|_{X^{\rm sm}}$ is the canonical identification of the statement. It commutes with restriction and base change because $\alpha$ does (step 7).

source.place: Tag 0E9Z smooth-locus assertion, using the canonical adjunction comparison; sheaves.tex Tag 04TN.

proof.text: Let $h:S^{\prime}\to S$ be arbitrary, and put $g:X^{\prime}\to X$. Over $h^{-1}(V)$ use the arbitrary-base-change comparisons of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction] and [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class] applied to the original Noetherian base $V$. They identify $g^*K_V$ and $g^*\alpha_V$ with the adjunction line and fundamental class of the pulled-back presentations. This does not apply a Noetherian-base theorem anew to $h^{-1}(V)$. In particular [lem-trf-flat-lci-presentation-base-change] supplies the conormal and differential identifications, Koszul exactness on the ambient charts, and regularity at points of the pulled-back closed subscheme, without assuming the new base Noetherian or the equations globally regular away from that subscheme. Its coherent comparison intertwines the presentation transitions given by determinants of the intrinsic conormal comparisons. By [lem-sfb-adjunction-cotangent-determinant-normalization], these are exactly the specified adjunction transitions, also after the base change, so it intertwines the old adjunction transitions with the pulled-back ones. Therefore the pulled-back $t_{ij}$ are exactly the transitions of these local constructions; [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules] glues the comparisons and their inverses. This yields the asserted identification of $g^*(K,\alpha)$ with the construction on the pulled-back presentations.

source.place: Tag 0E2Y; divisors.tex Tag 0FUD (remark-relative-regular-immersion-elements), as made precise in the cited presentation-base-change node.

proof.text: The Ext comparison also survives this arbitrary base change with its normalization. On a fixed polynomial chart, [lem-trf-lci-koszul-duality-determinant-comparison] describes it as the signed dual Koszul map, tensored with the coordinate volume line. In chosen ordered bases the Koszul matrices have entries $\pm f_j$, and the top pairing is contraction of the ordered exterior basis with its dual. Applying the coefficient homomorphism sends these entries to $\pm f_j^{\prime}$ and that pairing to the identical ordered pairing; evaluation and every fixed sign are unchanged. The pulled-back Koszul complex resolves the quotient by [lem-trf-flat-lci-presentation-base-change], so this is the Ext comparison for the new presentation as well. The same argument respects restriction and ring isomorphisms. Finally all line comparisons satisfy the identity and composition laws of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction], while the fundamental-class comparison respects restrictions, isomorphisms, and arbitrary base changes by [lem-sfb-lci-curve-fundamental-class]. Each claimed global compatibility reduces on the open cover to those equalities or to the displayed coefficient calculation, and hence holds by equality detection in [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules](1).
